firstGreen.reason: Enabled useAutoScroll also has an independent viewport-resize scroll listener. The first read budget incorrectly counted only the persistence listener. Preserve that listener, allow its one additional read and still require the shared value and a positive read.

readStackDiagnostic.reason: Temporary getter wrapper tried an unavailable original mock implementation. Its preserved stack identifies the viewport-resize listener. Wrapper removed.

firstLint.reason: UI package lies outside web config base path. Use explicit web config from repository root for that file.

uiLintPrelaunch.reason: ESLint executable is in apps/web, not apps root.

uiLint.reason: Existing unused borderSide destructuring in SessionPanel fails strict lint when this package is explicitly checked. Remove only that unused binding; the accepted prop type remains.

decision.reason: Streaming task-time rate is effectively flat: median paired reduction 0.011%, with three lower and three higher pairs. Streaming script rate improves only 0.70% by median paired change. The preliminary p95 signal is not confirmed: two pairs worsen about 12.4%, one improves 11.13%, and three stay within 0.1 ms. Median paired p95 improvement is effectively zero. Normal idle task rate improves 1.13% by median with two regressions; idle renderer CPU is mixed and idle maximum frame gaps worsen in five pairs. Reduced-motion idle work, streaming long tasks and cold readiness are mixed. Small selected savings do not establish a useful overall gain.

preservation.reason: Streaming task-time rate is effectively flat by median paired change. The preliminary p95 gain is not confirmed: two materially worse pairs, one materially better pair and three within 0.1 ms. Normal and reduced-motion idle work are mixed. No useful overall gain is established.

decision.navigationTiming: not run after rejected streaming confirmation
decision.nextAction: Attribute the 60 running idle animations and their actual viewport visibility on restored 9e20 before proposing another change. Keep all visible motion and semantic status behavior.

limits: Linux Chromium reference workload only. No M2 Air, field INP, battery or heap-leak claim.
Rate normalization uses each recorded window duration. Overlapping CDP metrics are separate measures and must not be added.
No results are pooled with intrusive render-count probes or other experiments.
Every attempt must pass before this comparison can support acceptance.
